title: Woman with Rose Offering
description: A woman in a pink floral dress sits on a teal couch, holding a blue bowl containing a vibrant red rose and blue berries. She gazes at an open picture frame displaying the same rose, set in a stylized living room with mosaic-patterned walls.
prompt: A woman with dark hair in an updo wearing a pink floral dress sits on a teal sofa in a retro living room, holding a blue bowl with a single red rose and blue berries. She is looking at an open picture frame on her lap that also displays the rose. The background features intricate circular mosaic patterns in shades of pink, blue and purple with warm dramatic lighting, stylized digital painting, cohesive color palette
